subject: Private deployment runbook / hardware validation — next steps
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acme.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 21 Feb 2027 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Private deployment runbook / hardware validation — next steps

Hi Jane —

Thanks for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned on the on-prem / air-gapped path for Acme Robotics: 

What we heard:
- Preferred deployment: Private (air-gapped) in Acme data centre, strict change freeze windows (monthly maintenance windows + quarterly major upgrades).
- Current target workload: low-latency inference for perception pipelines, bursty requests during production runs. Expect ~200 avg concurrent sessions, peak token throughput planned per week on forecast.
- Security/compliance: KMS via HSM, detailed audit logs, and SOC2 evidence required for vendor onboarding.
- Hardware inventory: you indicated mixed NVIDIA fleet (details to confirm).

Action items (owner / ETA):
1) Sean: share the Redwood private-deploy runbook + hardware matrix for validation (attached) — today.
2) Jane: fill the attached hardware inventory template with exact NICs, GPU model/VRAM, firmware versions, and any PCIe topology notes — by Thu, Feb 24.
3) Vanessa + Dylan: propose an offline upgrade MOP and a short validation checklist for our field engineering to test during the first install window — by Mon, Feb 28.
4) Acme & Redwood: schedule a 60-minute HW validation call (remote) to go through inventory and connectivity diagrams — link below.

Open questions we need answered before SOW:
- Are there enforced network egress restrictions (strictly no outbound except corp proxy)?
- Do you require airborne hardware custody or do we ship appliances for your team to install?
- What is your preferred maintenance window cadence and blackout periods?

Attachments: redwood-private-runbook-v2.docx, hardware-inventory-template.xlsx, initial SOW template (draft).

I put a 30-minute calendly link below for the validation call; if you prefer, propose times and we will accommodate.

Calendly: https://calendly.com/sean-gallagher/30min
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/ACME

Thanks — looking forward to the inventory file.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198

Redwood Inference — production-first inference platform for hosted, dedicated, and private deployments
From: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acme.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Castor <tom.castor@acme.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Feb 2027 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Private deployment runbook / hardware validation — next steps

Sean —

Thanks for the summary and for sending the runbook. A few clarifications from our side:

- Hardware inventory (preliminary): 3 x A100 40GB (PCIe) + 1 x A100 80GB (SXM4) in two different racks; Mellanox CX-6 100GbE NICs, dual management NICs. We will export exact PCIe topology and serials in the template.
- Change windows: we have a weekly 2-hour maintenance window (Tues 02:00–04:00 local) and a quarterly 6-hour major window where firmware and kernel-level changes are allowed. Any additional out-of-band work requires 4-week notice and an approved MOP.
- Security: We operate an HSM-based KMS (Thales). Keys cannot leave our secure perimeter; we require Redwood to support customer-managed keys and offline import procedures.
- Network egress: Strict outbound rules — only allowed to specific IP ranges through a proxy (we will share the list). For validation, we can open temporary egress to Redwood's test endpoints if needed, with an IRT on-call.

We'll fill the hardware-inventory-template.xlsx by end-of-day Thu (Feb 24). Also, can you confirm whether Redwood's field engineers require VPN credentials or an on-site admin to perform initial checks?

Tom (cc) will coordinate the calendar slots for the validation call.

Jane
Director, Infrastructure — Acme Robotics
jane.doe@acme.ai
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 23 Feb 2027 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Private deployment runbook / hardware validation — internal notes

Sean / Dylan —

Quick internal alignment:
- Jane confirmed mixed A100 fleet and strict egress + HSM requirements. We must ensure our private agent supports customer-managed keys in an air-gapped mode (we have a working path but Dylan, please validate the offline KMS workflow with engineering).
- Next steps for SE: draft an offline upgrade MOP (step-by-step, rollback path, verification checks) and a concise validation checklist (GPU health, NIC throughput, firewall/proxy tests, kernel/fw versions).
- Ops note: because they require 4-week notice for out-of-band changes, we should propose performing the initial staging in a non-prod rack during their weekly window and reserve the major window for the production cutover.

Can you own the SOW draft and the customer-facing MOP? I will prepare an internal install playbook variation for the field team.

Vanessa
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acme.ai>, Tom Castor <tom.castor@acme.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 24 Feb 2027 09:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Private deployment runbook / hardware validation — next steps

Jane / Tom —

Appreciate the quick clarifications — that inventory shape makes sense. A few concrete items before the validation call:

1) Inventory template: thanks — we will validate the file once you upload; please include firmware and BIOS versions where possible.
2) KMS/HSM: we support customer-managed keys and offline import for the private agent. Dylan, Vanessa and I will prepare a one-page MOP describing the key import, rotation, and emergency key-ceremony steps for your security team.
3) Egress: understood. If you can provide the proxy/IP list ahead of the call, we will prepare test endpoints and the minimal egress checklist.
4) Field access model: two options we support — (A) remote-guided install where your on-site admin runs the installer and provides temporary VPN; (B) Redwood on-site engineer performs install under an NDA (we can provide ADT and background). Please indicate preference and we'll include in the SOW.

Attached: redwood-private-runbook-v2.docx (updated with a short offline upgrade appendix), SOW-draft-ACME.docx, hardware-inventory-template.xlsx

Proposed time for HW validation call: https://calendly.com/sean-gallagher/30min — Tom, if you can propose two slots next week we will lock one.

If this looks good, Vanessa and I will iterate the SOW (scope + milestones) and share a DocuSign when you are ready.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198
